name: Princess Britania ~Muse no Houken~
source:
The protagonist Chloe is the heir of the great house of Sheffield whose warriors have long served the queen of Britania. 

Britania has been at war with the neighboring Hilbenia Republic for many years. At long last, the two nation's leaders have met to create a peace treaty. But the newly created peace is quickly threatened when the Hilbenian prince and his royal party are attacked on their way back home. 

It falls to Chloe to root out the truth of the attack and prevent their countries from falling back into war.
translation:
主人公克洛伊是谢菲尔德家族的继承人，谢菲尔德家族的战士们长期侍奉不列颠尼亚女王。

不列颠尼亚多年来一直与邻国希尔贝尼亚共和国交战。两国领导人终于会面并签署了和平条约。但当希尔本尼亚王子和他的皇室成员在回家的路上遭到袭击时，新建立的和平很快就受到了威胁。

克洛伊有责任找出袭击的真相并防止他们的国家重新陷入战争。
